mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmSellerCmpyMultiSelPopList*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.COM_CODE /* 협력사코드 */ , A.COM_NAME_LOC /* 협력사명 */ , A.CEO_NAME_LOC /* 대표자 */ , NVL(A.TEL_NO, A.GR_EMP_TEL) AS TEL_NO /* 전화번호 */ , A.BUSINESS_ITEMS /* 대표품목 : 공용 협력사 팝업(icomcmpyPop)의 취급품목과 같은 값 */ FROM ICOMCMPY A WHERE A.BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND UPPER(A.COM_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_agent_nm}) || '%' ORDER BY A.COM_NAME_LOC, A.COM_CODE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 300
